decision_rule: Among the probe windows that cleared their own comparison, the largest gap between any two wavelength-to-window-width ratios. Within 0.1 counts as a wavelength that scales with the window, once one shared wavelength has already been ruled out. Exactly one clearing window is undetermined and is never mixed.
metric: Largest gap between any two wavelength-to-window-width ratios, among the probe windows that cleared their own comparison.
notes: One shared wavelength is ruled out first; only then does a ratio within 0.1 count as a wavelength that scales with the window. Exactly one clearing window is undetermined and is never recorded as mixed. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
